data.key: Sorcerer Bonus Spell L6 ~ Planar Binding
data.name: Planar Binding
data.description: This spell functions like lesser planar binding, except that you may call a single creature of 12 HD or less, or up to three creatures of the same kind whose Hit Dice total no more than 12. Each creature gets a saving throw, makes an independent attempt to escape, and must be individually persuaded to aid you.|PRERULE:1,DisplayFullSpell
